#301 deployed AFTER cost receipt

Merged commit ed1e89113b59204102b03facbd1bf70d522c9c1c, daemon PID 13436, reported commit ed1e89113b. The performance role ended at merge; this is a governed note, not a new verdict or holding.

AFTER minute:
- UTC 2026-11-21T00:14:12.414869Z -> 00:15:12.464604Z; monotonic elapsed 60.020910875 s.
- PID, process start and deployed commit remained unchanged. ps reported process start Sat 21 Nov 10:12:51 2026 (host local).
- Launch counter 506 -> 506: zero launches, 0.0000 launches/s. The ten named operations below all stayed flat. No operation name absent from the round-1 BEFORE receipt appeared.
- CPU time 33.05 -> 43.26 s: +10.21 s, 17.0107% of one core.
- RSS 155,248 -> 143,888 KiB.
- daemon.log stayed at 1,506 bytes, with unchanged device/inode and mtime: +0 bytes / 60.0209 s = 0 bytes/minute. No rotation or shrink occurred during the window.
- A read-only scan of the entire 1,506-byte current log found no repeat-summary line to quote. This was a quiet-log window, not a live burst-reduction test; the earlier exact-source replay remains the burst proof.

Per-operation counters (start -> end, delta):
| Operation | Counter | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|
| ddocs.community | 6 -> 6 | 0 |
| gh.delivered | 1 -> 1 | 0 |
| git.community | 7 -> 7 | 0 |
| ps.registration-native-process | 194 -> 194 | 0 |
| ps.sidecar-process-group | 1 -> 1 | 0 |
| ps.tmux-harness-process-tree | 3 -> 3 | 0 |
| tmux.control-client | 1 -> 1 | 0 |
| tmux.pipe-pane attach | 145 -> 145 | 0 |
| tmux.rename-window | 3 -> 3 | 0 |
| tmux.set-options tap owner | 145 -> 145 | 0 |

These reconcile to the total (506 at both edges). The merged logger adds no production launch site, and the spawn-counter implementation is unchanged between 90e659cd16 and this merge.

Separate machine-wide AFTER window, `just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json`:
20.0 s, daemon PID 13436, 322.6 new PIDs/s; sampled 310.2/s, with lower-bound classes other 180.8/s and gone-before-seen 129.4/s. No daemon children were observed. Dominant sampled commands included bash 121.4/s and node 13.1/s. The measurement did not overlap the daemon's minute CPU window. This is a busy shared-machine measurement, not evidence that #301 causes 322.6 launches/s; short-lived children can evade the sampler.

BEFORE -> AFTER comparison:
| Metric | BEFORE 90e659cd16, PID 41256 | AFTER ed1e89113b, PID 13436 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Window elapsed | 60.028941 s | 60.020911 s |
| Daemon launches | 4 | 0 |
| Daemon launches/s | 0.066635 | 0 |
| CPU, % of one core | 13.5934% | 17.0107% |
| RSS, KiB | 132,272 -> 139,248 | 155,248 -> 143,888 |
| Separate machine launches/s | 92.8 | 322.6 |
| Log growth | not measured in BEFORE window | 0 bytes/min |

The BEFORE window was UTC 2026-11-20T22:57:09.629720Z -> 22:58:09.659504Z, recorded in the round-1 performance output. Its four launches were one each of tree-ps, pipe-pane attach, pipe-pane detach and set-options tap owner. Different daemon age, fleet activity and machine load prevent a causal CPU/RSS/machine-rate conclusion. In particular CPU did not decrease in these samples. The observed steady-state AFTER launch cost is zero, with no new launch operations.

Read-only metadata at UTC 2026-11-21T00:14:53.720679Z independently confirmed: daemon.log 1,506 bytes mode 0600; daemon.log.1 16,777,122 bytes mode 0600; daemon.log.lock 0 bytes mode 0600; .2 and .3 absent. The prime's existing backup was present at 22,336,409 bytes. Its contents were not read or modified.

Commands/evidence: two `pij-rs --json ping` readings separated by `time.sleep(60)`, with monotonic elapsed; `/bin/ps -p 13436 -o pid=,time=,rss=,lstart=` at both edges; read-only stat of known log names; O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW bounded summary scan; separate `just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json`. Structured receipts were retained in session artifacts. The initial attempt referenced a review worktree already removed after merge; its minute collector did not run, and the successful minute collector ran from the canonical checkout. The separate machine probe did succeed and was not repeated.

No live bounce, signal, log write, truncation, rotation, move, chmod, dependency change or repository edit was performed. No collector remains running. This supplies the previously owed after-deployment receipt.
